# TextShift Blog

> Official blog for TextShift — the AI content detection and humanization platform with 99.18% accuracy and 22 writing tools.

The TextShift Blog publishes expert content on AI writing, content authenticity, and digital content strategy.

## Content Categories
- **AI Detection** — How AI content detection works, accuracy benchmarks, model comparisons
- **AI Humanization** — Techniques for making AI text sound natural, bypassing detection tools
- **Plagiarism Detection** — Academic integrity, content originality, plagiarism prevention
- **SEO & Content Strategy** — SEO blog writing, content marketing, keyword optimization
- **AI Writing Tools** — Reviews, comparisons, and guides for AI writing assistants
- **Industry News** — Latest developments in AI content generation and detection

## Key Topics
- AI content detection accuracy and methods
- ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, Gemini detection
- AI text humanization techniques
- Plagiarism checking and prevention
- SEO content writing best practices
- AI writing tool comparisons and reviews

## About TextShift
- 22 AI-powered writing tools
- 99.18% AI detection accuracy (RoBERTa + TriBoost ensemble)
- 99.95% plagiarism detection accuracy
- 3 humanization modes (Academic, Professional, Casual)
- Trusted by 10,000+ users
- Free tier: 5,000 words/month
